basis: Independent audiovisual model observation, not human listening or production approval

first.one_viewing_summary: A clean 2.5D technical illustration clearly diagramming Contoro's dual-surface gripper engaging the front and side of an obscured box in a trailer stack.
observed_strengths: Immediate mobile readability: articulated arms and multi-cup suction pads clearly depict the physical grasping mechanism referenced in the source text.
Clear visual hierarchy between the box stack, roller conveyor, camera sensor mast, and gripper linkage.
Composed camera angles maintain uninterrupted focus on the contact zones and carton displacement.

defects.observed: The initial shot remains largely static on the front pad contact before the wider gantry reveal occurs.

second.one_viewing_summary: A 3D mesh rendering of the robot arm using primitive block geometry and unmotivated camera staging that wanders away from the primary unloading action.
observed_strengths: Presents spatial depth and perspective inside the trailer container.
Demonstrates physical motion of pulling the carton toward the roller bed.

defects.observed: The gripper end-effectors are modeled as undifferentiated solid black rectangular slabs, obscuring the functional suction mechanism described in the source.
The camera whip-pans and crops into an empty vertical support column and bare floor, losing sight of the carton stack and focal unloading action.

original_result.comparison_reason: First delivers significantly higher phone-size clarity and technical legibility. Its articulated suction arrays and composed orthographic angles explicitly communicate how Contoro grasps both the front and accessible side of a packed carton. Second relies on crude low-poly primitives with generic black blocks for grippers, compounded by an awkward mid-scene camera move that pans into an empty pillar.
original_result.audio_observed: Both cuts feature identical crisp, natural voiceover narration without distortion or clipping, synchronized perfectly with force-aligned subtitle captions and subtle mechanical ambient bed audio.
original_result.source_limits: Contoro's proprietary technology is illustrated based on company claims regarding front-and-side dual grasp and container sensing; customer-site operational autonomy rates and internal AI edge-case benchmarks remain unverified claims.
